status: research draft from Gemini Deep Research (G1), pending the C2 audit and a solicitor's review. Fees change every April; confirm before release. Scotland differs (Family Law (Scotland) Act 1985): matrimonial property only, pension split pro-rated to the marriage, maintenance capped at 3 years.
disclaimer: This app organises tasks and documents. It is not a substitute for advice from a solicitor, a regulated financial adviser or a tax adviser.

procedure_notes.reflection_period: At least 20 weeks from the divorce application before a conditional order can be applied for (Divorce, Dissolution and Separation Act 2020).
procedure_notes.final_order_wait: At least 6 weeks and 1 day after the conditional order before the final order.
procedure_notes.financial_order_timing: A consent order or pension sharing order can be approved at the conditional order stage but takes effect only after the final order (later of the final order or 28 days after the order, or 7 days after any appeal period).
procedure_notes.remarriage_trap: Remarrying before applying for a financial order bars the application (Matrimonial Causes Act 1973 s.28(3)). Confirm with counsel.
procedure_notes.cgt_window: No gain, no loss transfers between separating spouses run to the end of the third tax year after the tax year of separation, or without limit under a court order (Finance Act 2023 s.24 amending TCGA 1992 s.58).
procedure_notes.lifetime_allowance: Abolished from 6 April 2024; the Lump Sum Allowance is £268,275 and the Lump Sum and Death Benefit Allowance £1,073,100 (Finance Act 2024).

tasks.title: Sever the joint tenancy on the home
tasks.why: Until the joint tenancy is severed, the whole home passes to the surviving spouse automatically if one of you dies before the divorce is final.
how: Check the title register at HM Land Registry.
Serve a written notice of severance on your spouse and keep proof of service.
Apply to HM Land Registry with Form SEV to register a Form A restriction.

tasks.title: Register matrimonial home rights
tasks.why: If the home is in your spouse's sole name, registration stops it being sold or mortgaged without your knowledge. The right ends when the marriage ends.
how: Find the title number.
Complete Form HR1.
Lodge it with HM Land Registry and keep the confirmation.

tasks.title: Separate joint accounts and freeze joint credit
tasks.why: Joint account holders are jointly and severally liable for new overdrafts and debts.
how: Ask each bank for a both-to-sign mandate or a freeze on joint facilities.
Open a sole current account.
Redirect salary, benefits and direct debits.

deadline.legal_basis: FCA Banking Conduct of Business Sourcebook

tasks.professional: solicitor if funds are at risk

tasks.title: Make a new will
tasks.why: Separation does not change a will. If you die before the final order, your spouse inherits under the old will or under intestacy. Divorce only treats the ex-spouse as having died on the date of the final order.
how: Instruct a solicitor.
Revoke earlier wills, remove the spouse as beneficiary and executor, appoint substitutes.
Sign with two independent witnesses.

tasks.title: Revoke and remake lasting powers of attorney
tasks.why: Divorce ends a spouse's appointment as attorney, but separation does not. Until then your spouse can still act on your finances and health.
how: Sign a deed of revocation and serve it on your spouse.
Notify the Office of the Public Guardian.
Register new property and financial affairs and health and welfare LPAs (forms LP1F and LP1H).

tasks.title: Update pension expression-of-wish nominations
tasks.why: Pension death benefits and death-in-service lump sums do not pass under a will. Trustees pay at their discretion, guided by the nomination on file.
how: List every occupational and personal pension.
Ask each scheme for its nomination or expression-of-wish form.
File new nominations and keep the acknowledgements.

tasks.title: Claim the council tax single-person discount
tasks.why: A sole adult resident gets 25% off council tax from the date the other adult leaves.
how: Tell the council the date your spouse moved out.
Apply for the single-person discount online.
Check the revised bill.

tasks.title: Move Universal Credit or other benefits to a single claim
tasks.why: A joint claim must be closed when you separate. Late reporting creates recoverable overpayments and penalties.
how: Report the change of circumstances in the Universal Credit account.
Use the linking code to open a single claim.
Provide housing costs and income as a single claimant.

tasks.title: Get cash equivalent transfer values for every pension
tasks.why: The court needs a certified value for each pension before it can share or offset. Defined benefit schemes can take up to three months to produce one.
how: Send Form P to each scheme.
Ask whether the scheme allows internal or external transfer of a pension credit and what it charges to implement a sharing order.
Keep the valuation date on file.
tasks.fee: £0 for the annual statement; £250-1,000 for extra defined benefit valuations

deadline.legal_basis: Pensions on Divorce etc. (Provision of Information) Regulations 2000 reg.4

tasks.professional: family solicitor; pension actuary for large defined benefit pensions

tasks.title: Lodge the financial remedy consent order with Form D81
tasks.why: A divorce alone does not end financial claims. Without a court order either party can claim years later.
how: Agree the settlement and draft the consent order.
Complete Form D81 (statement of information) and Form P1 for each pension to be shared.
Apply through the HMCTS portal after the conditional order and pay the fee.
tasks.form: Form A; Form D81; Form P1

deadline.legal_basis: Matrimonial Causes Act 1973 s.24B; Family Procedure Rules 2010 Part 9

tasks.title: File a notice of disassociation with the credit agencies
tasks.why: Once joint credit is closed, disassociation stops your ex-spouse's credit history affecting yours.
how: Close or transfer every joint credit facility first.
Request a notice of disassociation from Experian, Equifax and TransUnion.
Keep the confirmations.

tasks.title: Serve the pension sharing order on the scheme
tasks.why: Nothing happens until the scheme receives the sealed final order, the pension sharing order with its annex, your details and its fee. The 4-month implementation clock only starts then.
how: Get sealed copies of the final order and the financial order with the Form P1 annex.
Give the scheme your National Insurance number and receiving-scheme details.
Send the bundle by recorded delivery and pay the implementation charge.
Log the date the scheme confirms it has everything.

deadline.legal_basis: Welfare Reform and Pensions Act 1999 s.34; Matrimonial Causes Act 1973 s.24B

tasks.title: Move private medical insurance into your own name
tasks.why: Cover as a spouse on an employer's scheme ends at the final order. Insurers usually allow a switch without new underwriting only within a short window.
how: Ask the insurer for the exact end date and a continuous-cover certificate.
Apply for an individual policy on continuation terms.
Check pre-existing conditions are carried over.

tasks.title: Transfer of equity and mortgage release
tasks.why: The order transfers the home; the lender must separately release the outgoing spouse from the mortgage. Until then both remain liable.
how: Get the lender's consent to the transfer and release.
Execute Form TR1 as a deed.
File the SDLT return claiming the divorce exemption.
Lodge TR1 and AP1 with HM Land Registry.
tasks.form: Form TR1; Form AP1; SDLT return

deadline.legal_basis: Land Registration Act 2002; Finance Act 2003 Sch.3 para.3

tasks.title: Revert your name and update ID
tasks.why: Passport, driving licence, HMRC, NHS and banks must match, or payments and travel fail.
how: Gather birth certificate, marriage certificate and the final order.
Renew the passport in the birth surname.
Send Form D1 to DVLA.
Notify HMRC, the GP practice, the electoral roll and banks.
tasks.agency: HM Passport Office; DVLA; HMRC; NHS

tasks.title: Cancel the marriage allowance transfer
tasks.why: If £1,260 of personal allowance was transferred between you, HMRC must be told or tax codes stay wrong and back tax follows.
how: Log in to the HMRC personal tax account.
Cancel marriage allowance, giving the final order date.

tasks.title: Monitor the 4-month pension implementation period
tasks.why: The scheme must implement the pension credit within 4 months of the later of the order taking effect and receiving all documents and charges.
how: Get written confirmation of the start date.
Choose internal or external transfer and provide receiving-scheme details.
Obtain the statement of implementation.
tasks.form: discharge of liability or option form

deadline.legal_basis: Welfare Reform and Pensions Act 1999 s.34(1)

tasks.title: Complete asset transfers inside the capital gains tax window
tasks.why: Transfers between separating spouses are at no gain, no loss until the end of the third tax year after the tax year of separation, or without limit under a court order. Outside that, tax is charged at market value.
how: List every asset transferred outside a court order.
Compute the cut-off from 5 April of the separation year.
Report disposals on the SA108 capital gains pages claiming s.58 treatment.

deadline.legal_basis: TCGA 1992 s.58(1)(b) as amended by Finance Act 2023 s.24

tasks.title: Check your State Pension forecast and fill National Insurance gaps
tasks.why: Under the new State Pension you cannot rely on an ex-husband's record. Gaps can be filled with voluntary Class 3 contributions.
how: Use Check your State Pension online (form BR19 by post).
Review qualifying years.
Ask the Future Pension Centre whether voluntary contributions pay off.
tasks.agency: Department for Work and Pensions; HMRC
tasks.fee: £0 forecast; Class 3 about £907 per year (2024/25, confirm)
